nodes.label: Final Audit Report (2026-09-10)
nodes.description: Audit from 2026-09-10 with 16 findings: 2 CRITICAL (C1: .env.testing with real APP_KEY, C2: leaked env backup CLOSED), 4 HIGH (H1: SMTP plaintext in system_settings, H2: default DB credentials, H3: no CI/CD, H4: stale docs), 4 MEDIUM (M1: console.log in Vue, M2: ingestion_service no retry, M3: large components, M4: binary files committed), 6 LOW/INFO. Execution GAP: backend tests not executed (no PHP/MySQL/Redis on Windows). What went well: event-driven architecture, polling eliminated, realtime delivery, database design, 580 tests at 99% pass rate, Docker Compose, accessibility, ADR documentation.
nodes.rationale: The most recent comprehensive audit. Identifies security vulnerabilities (APP_KEY exposure, SMTP credentials), CI gaps, and documents the test suite status. The 580 tests at 99% pass rate is the key quality metric.
